examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: To keep in memory. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'мнить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to remember'.

meanings.note: 'Послушай!' / 'Послушайте!' = Listen! (to get attention)

meanings.en: to try hard, do one's best
meanings.note: Followed by infinitive. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'стараться'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to try, make an effort', paired with 'стараться'.
